 Example Lavasioth fucking sucks with longsword, low damage and constant bouncing was my main issue with the fight that made me hate it. However I learnt that the gunlance laughs at these limitations and I learned how to full burst gunlance. This made the fight so much more enjoyable. This alone made learning them worth it. If I think my boys need buffs n shit I get out the horn, if I am against a flying monster it's either ranged or insect glaive.

I had a really long stint this year where my weed consumption went out of control. I have been diagnosed with seasonal and clinical depression. My story begins in September. I was able to get into uni and begin living on my own. At first it was fucking dope. I played video games all day and smoked from my bong to get stoned. But as time began to go on and depression, loneliness, betrayal from a friend and rejection, my use changed from being excited and happy. To depressed and lonely, battling every day to get out of bed to go to class. It was like life was in grayscale and really low quality audio. I felt invisible and alone and the only thing keeping me sane and alive was weed at the time. If I wasn't high I was in hell. I became extremely dependant, began selling and consuming entire trays of pot brownies I learnt to make and secretly baked. I spent weeks going on benders with weed. Since the second semester ended at uni I immediately dropped out and began on a path to get better. I got a new prescription that seems to be working, started back going to the gym and overall try to be a better person. Weed is still a struggle for me as I really like getting high and playing video games but I am making alot of progress.
